svg.title: Five-Host Cross-Silicon Fleet Energy Audit and 10 Siloed AI Camps vs Digital Enzymatic Synthesis (DES-10)
svg.desc: Two-panel dark-theme hardware benchmark figure for Study 21 (The Communication Tool Avalanche). Left panel (CTA-E4): 5-host cross-silicon audit comparing zero-clock OS-event threshold wakeup (Linux eventfd, Darwin kqueue+pipe, Win32 Event) against 1,000 Hz clocked polling across NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor physical TI INA3221 and INA238 shunt measured_j (CPU-only) and four reported_j hosts (Intel Core i9-13900H RAPL, AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 RAPL and amdgpu PPT, Apple M3 Ultra Darwin ri_energy_nj under memguard, and Windows 11 Pro RTX 2060 NVML and QueryProcessCycleTime), plus 50,000-iteration BLAKE3 and Ed25519 verification microjoules. Right panel (CTA-E5): 100-task, 5-regime matrix comparing all 10 siloed AI paradigm camps solo (C1 to C10, ceiling 49% pass) against DES-10 Digital Enzymatic Composite (98% verified pass, 1% false commits, 9.3x to 27.1x higher Coherence per Joule, and over 50,000x enzymatic handoff energy reduction).
svg.text: Five-Host Fleet Energy Audit & 10 Siloed AI Camps vs. Digital Enzymatic Synthesis (DES-10)
Separated Evidence Grammar: Thor TI INA3221/INA238 measured_j (CPU-only) vs. 4-Host RAPL / Darwin / NVML reported_j · Pre-reg SHA-256: 3efe6840…
A. CTA-E4: 5-Host Zero-Clock OS Threshold vs. 1,000 Hz Polling (5.0 s × 4 Pairs, 1% Duty)
win32_event · L3 CPU ms (7.7W GPU L2)
Zero-Clock OS Event (0 empty polls across all 5 OS kernels)
Compiled Rust BLAKE3 (256-bit) + Ed25519 (RFC 8032) Verify · 50,000 Iters / Host
Falsifier 2 passed on 5/5 hosts (<100 µs & <5 mJ/edge); Falsifier 6 shared-host co-tenant locks disclosed.
B. CTA-E5: 10 Siloed AI Camps vs. DES-10 across R1–R5 (100 Tasks × 2 Hosts)
Digital Enzyme Activation-Barrier Collapse (E_{a→b} Binary IR vs. Camp 9 Live NL Handoff)
• Jetson Thor (INA3221 VDD_CPU_SOC measured_j): 49.95 µs / 0.732 mJ vs. 3,938.5 ms / 55.14 J
→ 78,855× faster handoff & 75,374× lower physical DC shunt energy (16,189× via stdio pipe)
• Intel i9-13900H (RAPL pkg reported_j): 23.00 µs / 0.689 mJ vs. 3,577.6 ms / 36.38 J
→ 155,554× faster handoff & 52,815× lower socket energy · DES-10 CpJ: 9.3× C1 & 27.1× C9
Online crystallization (R3–R5 → C5 De Bruijn store) lifts R1 from 16/20 (C5 solo) to 20/20 at O(1) cost.
